subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different aspects of their purchase are Amazon reviewers actually talking about?

judge.implied_focus: The aspects/dimensions of a purchase that Amazon reviewers discuss (an aspect taxonomy of review content)

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Establishes the product type context that conditions which purchase aspects reviewers can talk about; a coherent facet of the aspect-taxonomy focus, though slightly more of a segmentation attribute than an aspect itself.

per_column.name: functional_performance_issue
per_column.rationale: Directly captures a major aspect reviewers discuss for physical/functional products (does it work, performs vs expectations); a clear aspect facet at useful granularity.

per_column.name: content_creative_quality
per_column.rationale: Captures the aspect reviewers discuss for media products (plot, writing, musical quality, etc.); a complementary aspect facet covering the media portion of the catalogue.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively centre on one coherent, data-inferable focus: the substantive aspects of the purchase that reviewers actually talk about. Two columns (functional_performance_issue, content_creative_quality) are genuine aspect facets, cleanly split along the functional-vs-creative divide that mirrors the product_category distribution, and each uses categorical value sets that decompose the aspect rather than restating it. product_category is a supporting segmentation dimension that scopes which aspects apply, giving a sound predictor/facet structure rather than a grab-bag or a single restatement. The 'not_present' values enable presence/absence analysis of each aspect. The implied focus is genuinely actionable: an analyst can quantify which aspects dominate per category and drill into performance vs creative complaints. Minor deductions: aspect coverage is not exhaustive (e.g., price/value, shipping, customer service aspects are absent), so the aspect decomposition is somewhat partial, and product_category leans toward context rather than a pure aspect.
